turns.text: Hi, this is Alex, am I speaking with Harbor Cable?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Chris. I'm an AI assistant calling for Vedant. I'm calling about the account under his name and going over the bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The monthly cost is higher than what's advertised. What promotions or adjustments are available on it right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The plan is $79.99 and that's the current rate for that tier. I can't lower the rate, but I can put a one-time $30 courtesy credit on the account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a student rate on this account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is a one-time credit the best you can do on the account? Nothing on the monthly?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nothing on the monthly. The $30 credit is what I've got.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, please apply the credit. When does it show up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It'll post to the current statement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a one-time $30 credit on the Harbor Cable account, monthly rate stays at $79.99. Thanks Chris, bye.

notes: A one-time credit lowers the next statement by $30, so action is reduced with saved 30. No date was given for it, so effective_date is null. $79.99 is the rate, not the saving.
